fields.label: Enable PEPPOL Integration
fields.description: Enable PEPPOL e-invoice sending and receiving for this site

fields.options:
This site is connected to PEPPOL e-invoice exchange via your Authorised Service Provider (ASP) Grynn GmbH's product TAPR.ch.

  • Sales Invoices: Mark invoices with 'Send via PEPPOL' checkbox. TAPR.ch will fetch and deliver them.
  • Purchase Invoices: TAPR.ch will push approved invoices to this site automatically.

Ensure Company, Customer, and Supplier records have their PEPPOL Participant IDs configured.
